Every few weeks an AI lab announces an "open-weight" model. Here's what that actually means, in plain English.

→ A model's weights are the billions of numbers it learned in training. They are the model
→ Open weights means you can download those numbers and run the model on

Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro is this week's open-weights story: a 3T-class model with a 1M-token context. Moonshot reports 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 - narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%) and ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%). Live on the Kimi API, with full weights promised by Nov
